CustomField.formula:
IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled"),
"Cancelled Shift – " & TEXT(DAY(Date_of_Service__c)) & "/" & TEXT(MONTH(Date_of_Service__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(Date_of_Service__c)) & " (" & Start_Time_Formula__c & " – " & End_Time_Formula__c & ")",
Service_Type__r.Name & " for " & Client__r.First_Name__c & " " & Client__r.Last_Name__c & " on " & TEXT(DAY(Date_of_Service__c)) & "/" & TEXT(MONTH(Date_of_Service__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(Date_of_Service__c)) & " from " & Start_Time_Formula__c & " to " & End_Time_Formula__c )
CustomField.label: Description
